questions.explanation: Lack of development is the opposite problem; the risk is over-development that displaces existing communities. Successful regeneration increases property values and attracts investment, which often displaces long-term residents and businesses unable to afford rising rents. Mitigation requires anti-displacement mechanisms: community land trusts (permanently affordable land), community benefits agreements, local hiring provisions, and preserving existing affordable housing.
